Today, 1/3 of food produced in the USA goes to waste. With Savery, you can buy delicious food from local restaurants at a discounted price!

Find nearby restaurants in the app, choose your dish, and save a meal knowing you’ve not let great food go to waste.

Food waste is a problem affecting countries worldwide. The U.S. is not an exception. In the U.S., around 150 million tons of food waste are generated annually, with associated costs estimated at 270 billion dollars.

Food waste means that a lot of the resources that go into food production get squandered. This means more expensive food, inefficient use of resources, such as water and oil, which all add to global warming.
